items.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007
items.q: I spoke to Mike Abene and Vince Mendoza and Chuck Owen... I spoke and talked at length with three of the arrangers out of the four.

ctx.x: How much input did you have with your arrangers?

I spoke to Mike Abene and Vince Mendoza and Chuck Owen. But I didn’t speak to the Dutch arranger that arranged two tunes on that, and I was sorry, and I think the producer was kind of sorry. I think he didn’t want me to actually communicate with them too much. He wanted, you know, some individuality there and that we’d all come together. But I spoke and talked at length with three of the arrangers out of the four.
